_comment: Portable app manifest for scripts/install-portable.ps1, driven by scripts/setup.ps1. Every sha256 below is a real value measured from the official release asset. 'assoc' lists the file types this app should be offered for (used by the link phase; Windows still requires one manual click per type to set a DEFAULT - see SKILL.md).

apps.name: JPEGView
apps.notes: Image viewing. Starts instantly, handles huge folders. Launched with no argument it opens its own NavPanel.png - normal. Put strings_zh.txt in place for a Chinese UI.

apps.name: MPC-BE
apps.notes: Video and audio with a normal player UI: playlist, Ctrl+Up/Down speed, Ctrl+L subtitles. Needs 7-Zip available for the .7z asset (scoop has it).

apps.name: MarkText
apps.notes: Markdown with live preview. Electron build, so first launch may raise SmartScreen (unsigned) - choose Run anyway.

apps.name: rclone
apps.notes: Command-line sync/backup to a NAS over SMB or WebDAV. `rclone mount` needs WinFsp (elevation) - map the drive with the OS instead.

apps.name: PhotoDemon
apps.notes: Portable photo editor. Its Crop tool can LOCK AN ARBITRARY ASPECT RATIO (m_IsAspectLocked in Tools_Crop.bas), which makes it the tool for cropping photos into wallpapers: set 3840x2160, drag, apply, save. No file associations on purpose - the fast viewer keeps those.
